topics.label: Lecture introduction and learning objectives
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the introductory welcome and learning objectives for the lecture.

topics.label: Conventional cancer therapies and cytotoxic chemotherapy
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics cover traditional cancer interventions including surgery, radiation, and cytotoxic chemotherapy alongside their associated toxicities and resistance mechanisms.

topics.label: Exploiting intrinsic vulnerabilities and DNA repair defects
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine therapeutic strategies that exploit specific cancer cell vulnerabilities, including hormone dependence, checkpoint defects, and synthetic lethality in DNA repair pathways.

topics.label: Targeted kinase inhibitors and mechanisms of resistance
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics focus on targeting oncogenic kinase signaling with small-molecule inhibitors and the various mechanisms of drug resistance that arise during treatment.

topics.label: Monoclonal antibodies and antibody-drug conjugates
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe how engineered monoclonal antibodies and antibody-drug conjugates target specific cell-surface proteins to eliminate cancer cells.

topics.label: Cancer immunology and T-cell-directed immunotherapies
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics discuss the basis of immune surveillance and strategies to reactivate, redirect, or engineer T cells to destroy tumors.

topics.label: Overarching challenges, mortality trends, and future directions
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics reflect on long-term survival trends, overarching clinical challenges, and emerging paradigms in future cancer management.
